seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [reflection,target] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w x1, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Frame-native: parse 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (corner 10 axis, corner 5 piece, any 11 = target); axis row = most corner-10 blocks; selection = axis 0 dot else piece 0 centres grown through non-9 centres.
A1/A2 move selected axis/piece one row, A3/A4 move a piece one column (axis no-op); pieces blocked by edges/other pieces, axis passes under pieces; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Reflections: each off-axis piece block mirrors to row 2A-r unless off-board or piece-covered; render stack piece>refl>target>axis, centre = first solid (target 11, selected axis 0) else first fill (sel piece 0, refl 4) else 9.
HUD: column 63 gains one 12 (top-down) per effective action; row 63 static. Stateless, no hidden state needed.
Hint (reflection A1 h,pixels,w vs gone) = object re-extraction as reflections merge/occlude; irrelevant in frame space. Unconfirmed: splitting touching unselected pieces.
